2608.30050.title: Spec2Twin-Chain: Orchestrating Bi-Level Optimization with LLMs for Blockchain Digital Twin Construction
2608.30050.paper_summary: Building a blockchain digital twin largely requires translating domain knowledge and specific system descriptions into a simulator architecture, calibrating its parameters against behavioral evidence, and validating the constructed twin. These steps are commonly performed through application-specific modeling efforts that can be difficult to reuse across systems and downstream decision problems. We consider automating this process through Spec2Twin-Chain, a framework that formulates blockchain digital-twin construction as a bi-level optimization problem. At the upper level, a large language model proposes and revises structurally admissible architectures using system specifications, behavioral evidence, and feedback from evaluated designs. At the lower level, a simulation-based optimizer calibrates the architecture-conditioned parameters under explicit objectives and guardrail constraints. The two levels iterate. The evaluated candidates at lower levels are retained in a global archive and used to guide subsequent proposals at upper levels. We conduct controlled experiments involving twin calibration, feedback-driven recovery, stress analysis, downstream policy optimization, and policy updating. The results demonstrate that the framework can construct behaviorally accurate twins, improve initial designs through iterative feedback, and reuse calibrated twins to support downstream decisions.
2608.30050.paper_summary_zh: 建立區塊鏈數位雙胞胎在很大程度上需要將領域知識和特定系統描述轉換為模擬器架構，根據行為證據校準其參數，並驗證所構建的雙胞胎。這些步驟通常通過特定應用的建模工作來執行，而這些工作在不同系統和下游決策問題之間可能難以重用。我們考慮通過Spec2Twin-Chain自動化這一過程，這是一個將區塊鏈數位雙胞胎構建公式化為雙層優化問題的框架。在上層，一個大型語言模型使用系統規範、行為證據和來自評估設計的反饋，提出和修訂結構上可接受的架構。在下層，一個基於模擬的優化器在明確的目標和護欄約束下校準架構條件的參數。這兩個層級進行迭代。在下層評估的候選者保留在全球檔案中，並用於指導上層的後續提案。我們進行了控制實驗，涉及雙胞胎校準、基於反饋的恢復、壓力分析、下游政策優化和政策更新。結果顯示，該框架能夠構建行為上準確的雙胞胎，通過迭代反饋改善初始設計，並重用校準的雙胞胎以支持下游決策。
